projectDescription: A free browser tank arcade inspired by the 2010 classic — no registration, no pay-to-win, playable instantly in any browser with 7 hulls, 9 turrets, 101 paints, and 91 maps.
keyFeatures: No registration — pick a call sign and start playing immediately
No pay-to-win — all supplies are free, infinite, and equal for every player
7 hulls (Wasp to Mammoth) and 9 distinct turrets, all unlocked from the first second
91 battlefields including summer and winter variants, plus a built-in map editor
101 purely cosmetic paints with no gameplay effect
5 game modes: Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Assault, Explore Map
Progressive Web App — installs on mobile without an app store
Server-side outcome verification to prevent cheating
Static Next.js 15 landing page exportable to GitHub Pages or any static host
publicApiSurface: Next.js config: output: 'export', trailingSlash: true, images.unoptimized: true
App Router entry points: app/layout.jsx (metadata, font), app/page.jsx (full landing page)
Global styles: app/globals.css (dark palette, hover effects)
Static assets directory: public/assets/ (webp screenshots, logo, icon, supply icons)
